purpose: Predeclared gate for issue #7; calibration is not qualification
metric: Full preparation context wall time, including lease teardown and final verification
failurePolicy: Any failed/missing sample, incorrect work set, source mutation during measured runs, or exceeded limit fails qualification. Preserve failures and investigate; do not relax this budget retrospectively.
comparisonPolicy: Report ordinary MSBuild and adapter preparation, analysis, build, test and end-to-end timings separately. Explicit test preparation remains fresh. No scale or cross-platform speedup claim.
rationale: Calibration found 62% and 79% median preparation regressions. The ratio gate requires removing those regressions before the MVP performance gate can pass; the 5-second absolute guardrail bounds interactive preparation cost. Current calibration does not satisfy the ratio gate.
